slides.title: Modals of deduction in the past
slides.subtitle: must have, might have, can't have

head: Modal
Certainty
Example
rows: She **must have forgotten**. She never misses class.
You **can't have seen** him. He's in Spain.

items.q: The streets are wet. It ___ rained.
She ___ written this. She doesn't speak German.
I don't know where my keys are. I ___ left them at work.

items.t: He passed without studying? He ___ have cheated! (seguro)
They ___ have arrived yet. The flight lands at 6. (imposible)
